newsitem.title: MEXICO: Gruma announces share capital increase.
newsitem.headline: Gruma announces share capital increase.

text.p: Gruma SA, the holding company of corn flour maker Grupo Industrial Maseca, said Tuesday it will increase Gruma's share capital by 92.19 million pesos through an issue of 6,840,537 shares.

In a statement sent to the Mexican Stock Exchange, Gruma said shareholders would have the right to buy one new share for every 50 owned from May 8. Gruma said that those with insufficient shares to make up packets of 50 shares can cover the difference with cash payments.
For those not interested in purchasing new shares, their holdings will be paid off in cash.
